=== CALLEE SUMMARY ===
The method is supposed to copy attributes from a source node to an element.  
It operates on a source node and a target element.  
It iterates over the source node's attributes, sanitizes the attribute names, and sets them on the element.  
The method is supposed to produce an element with copied and sanitized attributes.  
At line 2, it calls attributes(). attributes()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to retrieve the attributes of a node. It achieves this by accessing and returning the collection of key-value pairs associated with the node.  
At line 3, it calls getKey(). getKey()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to retrieve the key of an attribute. It achieves this by accessing and returning the stored key value associated with the attribute instance.  
At line 4, it calls getValue(). getValue()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to retrieve the value of an attribute. It achieves this by accessing and returning the stored value associated with the attribute in the HTML element.  
At line 2, it calls iterator(). iterator()'s intention is The method's primary purpose is to provide a way to traverse through the elements of an Attributes object. It achieves this by returning an iterator that allows sequential access to each attribute within the collection.
